Notes.A: Important: If you do not have free space in your inventory for the rewards from a campaign or side quest you will not receive them. Before completing any campaign quest make sure you have two free inventory spaces. Side quests also have the same issues, but require up to six free invenotry spaces. LOH campaign and side quest weapons will not be received by classes that can not use them. Neyrelle's Defiance, Bitter Flamberge, Pilgrim's Staff and Diluvian Blade are the only exceptions.

LOH has brought huge changes to both gambling and how/where many items drop. There are now some items that only drop in specific regions now. The Glorious, Primal and Runic items are now world drops. Glorious items will not drop before character level 65. I strongly suspect the Primal and Runic items also have a level requirement on them above 60, but can not reasonable confirm that as it is very uncommon to see legendary items below level 70 now. The percentages have change for everything when gambling. Legendary items don't out pace rare and magic items as gambling drops until T10 and are most common in T12. While non-Torment difficulties will likely still yield the most rare and magic items it is no longer the best difficulties to gamble them in. The drop rate for legendary items is low enough now it likely is better to gamble for rare and magic items between T1 to T8 to allow for GA items and an increased chance at unique items. Common items are still best gambled at character level 1 in normal.

All the items received are normally based off the class you are playing and you do not normally receive items for other classes while gambling, killing monsters or opening chests. For Example: You can not receive Druid only staves while gambling with a Sorc.

For most activities what items you get are completely based off RNG, so there is no guaranteed way to get most items except for the unique quest/achievement reward items or PVP vendor items. In the Items sheets I have listed every item I know of that uses each cosmetic and have a notes column with the best general way(s) I know to find each item.

All items only drop at one quality (common, magic, rare, legendary and unique). There are only 4 items in the game that drop at multiple qualities do to errors in their .itm files. All other items that appear at multiple qualities with the same name and cosmetic do so because there are multiple .itm files involved. Mythic rarity in my sheet now refers to Iconic Mythic items. Mythic items drop using a different mechanic and do not drop from the general item pool any longer.

The Shared column tells you if I found another item that uses the same cosmetic and the item1-4 columns list the names of the items I found using that cosmetic. Often it is just another random common, magic or rare item, but sometimes it is unique item that can be easier to get.

The Theme column mostly applies to armor cosmetics. I include it in my lists for two reasons. The first is I find it handy to sort by frequently for the armor cosmetics. The second is it is easier to talk about armor cosmetics sets than individual pieces normally. I’m unaware of any official source for the in game earnable armor cosmetic set theme names, but most sets have an obvious theme name built in. For the few sets that do not I went with what I thought sounded best.

It is worth mentioning an issue I ran into with focus now that I've looked at the .itm files and I think there was more to it than bad RNG. They have two different values for focuses in the .itm files, Focus and FocusBookOffHand. When I initially built this guide over the course of Seasons 7, 8 and 9 I found I could not gamble Fiendish Folio (Spellbook cosmetic), Blood Orb (Spellbook) and Enigma Cube focuses. I only found them as random drops from mobs or chests. Interestingly they all have the FocusBookOffHand instead of Focus value unlike every other common, magic, rare and legendary focus in the general drop pool. If you are gambling for one of those three items you may not get one. Fiendish Folios are a common drop for low level Necros, Sorcs, and Warlocks. I have had success finding Enigma Cubes in the Pit.

LOH has diminished Fayira's, the Pale Marks vendor, value as a source for cosmetics greatly. The cosmetics on the items she sells directly are fixed. There are only two cosmetics she offers per item type. One is only offered on the rare items and the other is only offered on the legendary items. The weapons she sells directly can be salvaged for their cosmetics. However do to an error in the .itm files for the armor she sells directly you can not salvage it for the Nahantu themed armor cosmetics. Her caches are still good sources for armor cosmetics, but do to the increased cost by the time you can afford buying them in mass gambling is probably a better option. Same is likely true for the legendary weapons she sells. She does offer rare weapons frequently now, so if you are missing the one cosmetic she offers on a rare item she can be an excellent source for it. I have all the weapons she sells directly marked in my guide.
